source: 648 Teamwork
target: 648 Collaboratio

source: On the top floor of the beige building belonging to the patrol team, a middle-aged man in a thin black suit heard Jenna’s voice.
target: In tabulato superiore aedificii beige, quod turmae praesidiariae pertinebat, vir mediae aetatis in tenue veste nigra vocem Jennae audivit.

source: Without bothering to trace the source of the shout, he stood up abruptly and retrieved a white human skull, seemingly carved from crystal, from his hidden pocket.
target: Negligens fontem clamoris indagare, subito surrexit et album calvarium humanum, quasi ex crystallo sculptum, ex sinu secreto extulit.

source: The man, a mix of Intis and West Balam lineage, held the crystal skull and recited a mysterious language with a strong sense of death.
target: Vir, mixtura originum Intis et West Balam, calvarium crystallinum tenuit et linguam arcanam cum grave sensu mortis recitavit.

source: In the next moment, a decaying palm extended from the void in front of him.
target: In proximo momento, palma putrida ex vacuitate coram eo protensa est.

source: Its joints were thick, and its skin was bleeding, revealing signs of decay.
target: Articulationes eius crassae erant, et cutis eius sanguine stillabat, signa corruptionis ostendens.

source: The palm belonged to a corpse that looked vaguely human but, upon closer inspection, resembled a monster.
target: Palma cadaveri pertinebat, quod vago modo humanum videbatur, sed propiore inspectione monstrum simile apparuit.

source: Over 1.8 meters tall, its face concealed by a rusty bronze mask, and its torso composed of corpses from various species, including lions, tigers, black wolves, baboons, giant serpents, vultures, and humans themselves–all in a severe state of rot.
target: Altus plus quam 1.8 metra, facies eius sub larva aenea rubiginosa abscondita, et truncus eius ex cadaveribus variorum specierum compositus, inter quos leones, tigrides, lupi nigri, babiones, serpentes ingentes, vultures, atque ipsi homines – omnes in statu severo putredinis.

source: The corpse’s bronze mask flickered with dark‐red lights in its eyes as it took a step forward, arriving in Camus’s office.
target: Larva aenea cadaveris in oculis suis lucibus obscuro‐rubris micabat, dum passum in ante se faciens, ad officinam Camus pervenit.

source: Faced with Camus, who had a revolver in his right hand, staggering toward his forehead, the monstrous corpse removed its bronze mask.
target: Obvius Camus, qui revolverum in manu dextra gerebat et ad frontem se tendens titubabat, cadaver monstrum larvam aeneam sustulit.

source: Underneath the mask, there was no nose, flesh, or bones. Only two dark‐red balls of light and a mouth that occupied four‐fifths of the head.
target: Sub larva neque nasus neque caro neque ossa erant. Soli duo globi lucis obscuro‐rubri et os, quod quattuor quintas capitis occupabat, extabant.

source: The mouth opened wide, revealing a pitch‑black interior.
target: Os late aperuit, intimum nigerrimum revelans.

source: A terrifying suction force emanated from the mouth, affecting Camus’s spirit but having no effect on the documents, newspapers, and other items on the desk. It only caused Camus’s spirit to surface, as if pulled by an invisible force, about to be plunged into hell.
target: Ex ore procedebat vis terribilis sugendi, quae animam Camus attigerat sed documentis, diurnis, aliisque rebus in mensa nullum effectum habebat; sola causa fuit ut anima Camus emergeret, quasi vi invisibili tractus, in inferos imminens.

source: As Camus’s Spirit Body materialized, the grayish‑white clown seeped out of his flesh, revealing its complete form–a magnified, illusory poker card.
target: Cum corpus spiritale Camus apparuit, scurra cinereo‑albaceus ex carne eius effluxit, totam formam suam revelans – cartam pokeram ampliatam et illusoriam.

source: The poker card had no body of its own and was swiftly drawn out by the pitch‑black mouth beneath the bronze mask. Camus’s Spirit Body struggled.
target: Carta poker, propria corpori vacua, celeriter extrahita est a nigro ore sub larva aenea; corpus spiritale Camus luctabatur.

source: Smack!
target: Percussio!

source: The poker card materialized and fell to the ground, emitting the sound of a heavy object colliding with solid bricks, but there was no metallic sound.
target: Carta poker apparuit et in terram cecidit, sonum emittere obiecti gravis, qui cum lateribus solidis concurreret, sed sonus metallicus non audiebatur.

source: In the Matani Import and Export Shop, the male bathroom lay in ruins.
target: In Taberna Importationis et Exportationis Matani, latrina virorum in ruinis iacebat.

source: The door and the wall facing the corridor crumbled into fragments, scattering for several meters, as if a storm had passed through.
target: Ianua et paries, quae coridorio opposita erant, in fragmenta conciderunt, dispersa per plures metra, quasi tempestas transisset.

source: The Bottle of Fiction had lost its effect.
target: Ampulla Fictionis effectum suum amisit.

source: Amidst the residual fragments of light and the lingering sulfur smell, Twanaku rolled out in his Devil form.
target: Inter residua fragmenta lucis et odorem sulfuris manentem, Twanaku in forma Diaboli convolutus est.

source: His pitch‑black skin bore hideous wounds, and his flesh seemed to evaporate.
target: Cutis eius nigerrima vulnera abhorentia portabat, et caro eius quasi evanescere videbatur.

source: Half of the two curved goat horns on his head were gone, and viscous black liquid flowed from the cracks.
target: Dimidium duorum cornuae caprinae incurvarum super caput eius deesset, et liquidus viscosus niger ex fissuris deflabatur.

source: The bat‑like wings on his back were tattered and drooping.
target: Alae vespertilionis similes in dorso eius laceratae et pendent erant.

source: With Twanaku’s formidable physical strength, the Hurricane of Light from the Pride Armor shouldn’t have caused such tragic and severe damage, but he was a Devil.
target: Cum vi physica Twanaku formidabili, Turbo Lucis ex Armatura Superbiae non debuit tanta tragoedia et gravia damna inferre; at ille Diabolus erat.

source: The Hurricane of Light possessed the unique ability to destroy evil creatures and undead beings.
target: Turbo Lucis facultatem singularem habebat ad creaturas maleficas et ambulantes mortuos vincendos.

source: It was like Twanaku undergoing purification while being sliced by a fragmentary blade.
target: Sicut Twanaku purificationem subiret, dum gladio fragmentario concisus esset.

source: What made it more potent was their collaboration.
target: Quod id magis efficaciter faciebat, erat eorum collaboratio.

source: Purification weakened defense and inflicted harm on the evil creature’s spirit and flesh, while the fragmentary blade utilized purification to weaken defense and cut through flesh.
target: Purificatio defensionem debilitabat ac spiritum et carnem creaturae maleficae laedebat, dum gladius fragmentarius purificationem ad debilitandum defensionem et ad carnem caedendum utebatur.

source: The more wounds and the deeper they were, the better the purification effect.
target: Quo plura vulnera et quo profunda erant, eo melius effectus purificationis apparuit.

source: Had Twanaku not resisted in his Devil form and instead transformed into a Wraith, he might have faced severe injury, teetering on the brink of death, or even elimination.
target: Si Twanaku non repulisset in forma Diaboli sed in umbram se converteret, fortasse gravia vulnera passurus fuisset, in limine mortis vacillans, aut etiam exterminationem adeptus fuisset.

source: The Hurricane of Light could vanquish Wraiths and injure evil spirits.
target: Turbo Lucis umbras vincere et spiritus malignos laedere poterat.

source: Despite being severely injured, Twanaku, still capable of combat, calmly suppressed his tyrannical and blood‑thirsty emotions.
target: Quamquam graviter vulneratus, Twanaku, adhuc pugnandi facultate praeditus, tranquille affectus tyrannicos et sanguisuge reprimēns repressit.

source: Realizing he had escaped the seal, he prepared to transform into a Wraith and escape through the surrounding mirrors.
target: Cum intellexisset se sigillum effugisse, praeparavit ut in umbram se converteret et per specula circumiecta evaderet.

source: Just as he made this decision, a sudden sense of Danger Premonition struck him.
target: Statim quo hanc decisionem ceperet, repente sensus praenotionis periculi eum percussit.

source: The malice came from behind, and in the shadows outside the bathroom, Franca, dressed in an Assassin suit, emerged, raising her left hand.
target: Malitia a tergo venit, et in umbris extra latrinam, Franca, induta habitu sicarii, apparuit, manum sinistram attollens.

source: On her left thumb, she wore an iron‑colored ring with a thick band and a surface covered in small spikes–Ring of Punishment!
target: In pollice sinistro anulum ferreum gerebat, fascia crassa et superficie parvis spiculis ornatum – Anulus Poenae!

source: Franca’s lake‑blue eyes flickered with lightning, moving many times faster than the fastest bullets, shooting out silently with
target: Psychic Piercing!

source: Hidden Blade… Why do I only sense her malice now… The severely injured Twanaku couldn’t dodge in time and suddenly heard an illusory shattering sound.
target: Lamina Occulta… Cur nunc solum eius malitiam sentio… Twanaku, graviter vulneratus, tempore evadere non potuit et subito sonitum fracturam illusorium audivit.

source: The shattering sound echoed from Twanaku’s Spirit Body, and intense pain flooded his mind, compelling him to raise his hands to cover his head.
target: Sonus fractus ex corporibus spirituali Twanaku resonabat, et dolor intensus mentem eius inundavit, compellens eum manus tollere ad caput tegendum.

source: Seizing the opportunity, Franca swiftly took out a mirror and reflected Twanaku in his Devil form.
target: Occasionem arripiente, Franca speculum celeriter extraxit et Twanaku in forma Diaboli repraesentavit.

source: Black flames ignited in her left palm as she smeared it across the mirror’s surface–
target: Flammae nigrae in palma sinistra eius accensae sunt, dum eam per superficiem speculi ungebat –

source: Demoness’s curse!
target: Maledictio Daemonissæ!

source: Black flames erupted from Twanaku’s body, but nearly two‑thirds were suppressed by his flesh and blood, leaving only a portion of the colossal Devil’s Spirit Body to be incinerated.
target: Flammae nigrae ex corpore Twanaku erupserunt, sed fere duas partes trium ab carne et sanguine eius repressae sunt, relinquentes tantum partem colossalis corporis spirituali Diaboli ad incinerandum.

source: Being a Devil, immune to curses to a certain extent, helped Twanaku endure the Demoness’s curse better, given his already ravaged state from the Hurricane of Light.
target: Quia Diabolus erat, et ad maledicta ad aliquam rationem immunis, Twanaku maledictum daemonissæ melius sustinere potuit, praesertim statu iam devastato ex Turbo Lucis.

source: Finally free from the influence of Psychic Piercing, Twanaku, with his Spirit Body engulfed in black flames, transformed into a pitch‑black, viscous liquid.
target: Denique, liber a vim "Psychic Piercing", Twanaku, cum corpus spiritale in flammis nigris involutum esset, in liquidum nigerrimum et viscosum transformatus est.

source: These liquids seemed to originate from the darkest corners of the human heart, representing the most sinister and shadowy desires and emotions.
target: Hi liquidi videbantur ex obscurissimis angulis cordis humani oriri, repraesentantes desideria et affectus sinistrissimos atque umbratissimos.

source: Twanaku abandoned Wraith Form, choosing Desire Apostle’s Desire Incarnation because Demoness’s black flames targeted the Spirit Body more.
target: Twanaku formam umbræ reliquit, optans incarnationem Desiderii Apostoli, quoniam flammae nigrae daemonissæ corpus spiritale magis petebant.

source: Before the pitch‑black viscous liquid could fully elongate into a human figure, he fled into the nearby darkness, sensing a strong Danger Premonition in his heart.
target: Priusquam liquidum nigerrimum viscosum in figuram humanam omnino extendi potuisset, fugit in tenebras proximas, sentiens fortem praenotionem periculi in corde.

source: At the corridor’s entrance, Anthony Reid, donned in military‑green attire, appeared in a blind spot.
target: Ad introitum coridorii, Anthony Reid, in vestitu viridi militari indutus, in angulo obscuro apparuit.

source: His eyes took on a faint golden hue, transforming into vertical pupils—Psychological Invisibility!
target: Oculi eius leviter fulgore aureo colorati sunt, in pupillas verticales mutantes—Invisibilitas Psychologica!

source: Frenzy!
target: Furor!

source: Twanaku’s mind buzzed, instantly breaking free from his Desire Incarnation state. Blood‑shot eyes and livor mortis appeared on his body, emitting sulfurous blood.
target: Mens Twanaku fremuit, statim ex statu incarnationis Desiderii evadens; oculi eius rubentes et livor mortis in corpore apparuerunt, sanguinem sulfurosum efferentes.

source: He entered a frenzied state. Already grievously injured and subjected to Psychic Piercing and the Demoness’s curse, he was on the verge of losing control.
target: In statum freneticum incidit. Iam graviter vulneratus et sub "Psychic Piercing" atque maledictione daemonissæ, ad imperium sui amittendum labebatur.

source: Rumble!
target: Rugitus!

source: Light‑blue sulfur fireballs pelted the surroundings, propelled by Twanaku’s wild instincts.
target: Globuli ignis sulfuris caerulei circumiectos deiecerunt, impelluntur instinctibus feris Twanaku.

source: Franca’s form quickly shattered into mirror fragments, while Anthony’s body sprouted grayish‑white dragon scales. He leaped toward the wall for cover.
target: Forma Francae celeriter in fragmenta speculi concidit, dum corpus Antonii squamas draconis cinereo‑albaceas edidit; ille ad parietem saliens ad tegimen confugere quaesivit.

source: Rumble!
target: Rugitus!

source: Using up Franca’s Mirror Substitution, Lumian teleported behind the frenzied Twanaku.
target: Substitutione speculi Francae adhibita, Lumian post Twanaku frenetico teletransportatus est.

source: Having already unleashed the accumulated spirituality and strength within him, Lumian’s spirituality surged, no longer drained.
target: Iam, postquam spiritualitas atque vis in se congregatae fuerunt, spiritualitas Lumiani erexit, non amplius exhaurita.

source: Enduring the scorching sulfur flames and the blast’s impact, Lumian focused on the oblivious, frenzied Twanaku. He harrumphed.
target: Flammis sulfuris comburientibus ac ictu explosionis tolerans, Lumian in Twanaku frenetico intendit et 'Harrumph!' exclamavit.

source: Two beams of white light shot from his nose, hitting what appeared to be Hisoka.
target: Duo radii lucis albae ex naso eius emissi sunt, percutientes id quod videbatur esse Hisoka.

source: Twanaku collapsed, and the signs of madness began to fade.
target: Twanaku cecidit, et signa insanitatis evanescere coeperunt.

source: Lumian didn’t allow him to reach the ground. Extending his right hand, he grabbed Twanaku by the shoulder and teleported him into the spirit world!
target: Lumian eum terram attingere non sinxit; manu dextro extendens, Twanaku ab umero arripuit et eum in mundum spiritualem teletransportavit!

source: In seconds, Lumian materialized at the edge of the primitive forest near Port Pylos.
target: In secundis, Lumian se materializavit ad oram silvae primitivae prope Portum Pylos.

source: Even during this process, he let out a harrumph. The pale‑yellow light emitted from his mouth knocked Twanaku out again, preventing him from regaining consciousness.
target: Etiam in hoc processu, 'Harrumph!' exclamavit. Lumen pallidum flavum, quod de ore eius effluens erat, Twanaku iterum incoscientem fecit, ne conscientiam recipere posset.

source: At that moment, a woman stood at the edge of the primitive forest. It was Hela, dressed like a black widow but not as distant as before.
target: Illo momento, femina ad oram silvae primitivae stabat. Ea fuit Hela, induta ut aranea nigra, sed non tam remota quam antea.

source: Observing Twanaku, no longer in his colossal Devil state but emitting a sulfuric scent, with dark patterns on his skin, Hela nodded at Lumian and said, “It should be Hisoka.”
target: Observans Twanaku, iam non in statu Diaboli colossali sed odor sulfuricus egerens et cum obscuris figuris in cute, Hela Lumiani caput annuit et dixit: “Hisoka esse debet.”

source: Every time Hisoka participated in the Curly‑Haired Baboons Research Society, he only disguised himself superficially. If Hisoka’s true identity was targeted, Hela, who was responsible for providing the gathering venue and entrance method, could still recognize him.
target: Quotiescumque Hisoka in Societate Investigationis Papionum Crispi‑capillatorum participabat, se tantum superficialiter celabat; si identitas eius vera petita esset, Hela, quae locum conventus atque modum ingressus procurabat, eum adhuc agnosci posset.

source: “Ha!” Lumian chuckled and added a new Spell of Harrumph to Hisoka.
target: “Ha!” Lumian subridens exclamavit et novum incantamentum “Harrumph” Hisokae adiunctum est.

source: Hela seized his arm and chanted an incantation.
target: Hela bracchium eius arripuit et incantationem recitavit.

source: The two of them, along with Hisoka, vanished like pencil drawings erased by an eraser.
target: Hi duo, una cum Hisoka, evanuerunt sicut delineationes graphicae quasi ab calamaro deletae.

source: In the ancient and dilapidated palace of the Nation of the Evernight.
target: In antiquo et dilapidato palatio Nationis Perpetuae Noctis.

source: As Lumian emerged from his concealed state, he harrumphed.
target: Dum Lumian ex statu suo abscondito emersit, "Harrumph!" exclamavit.

source: Two beams of white light descended, and Hisoka remained unconscious.
target: Duo radii lucis albae descenderunt, et Hisoka inconscia permanuit.

source: Hela’s tone chilled as she remarked, “I’ll let you enter the same dream.”
target: Vox Helae glaciei pervulgata est, dum dixit: “Te in eundem somnium introitum concedam.”

source: “Thank you.” Lumian released Hisoka, reclining against a broken stone pillar.
target: “Gratias.” Lumian Hisokam dimisit, reclinans contra columnam lapidea fractam.

source: Moments later, his thoughts blurred until he heard Hela’s voice.
target: Momentis post, cogitationes eius confundebantur, donec vocem Helae audivit.

source: “It’s done.”
target: “Consummatum est.”

source: Lumian snapped back, gazing into the interrogation room where Hisoka sat opposite.
target: Lumian cito rediit, aspectans in cellam interrogationis, ubi Hisoka adverso sedebat.

source: This member of the Curly‑Haired Baboons Research Society, Twanaku Tupián, bore light‑brown skin, a blend of Northern and Southern Continent descent. His eyes gleamed flaxen, his hair dark. While not unattractive, his demeanor exuded indifference to life.
target: Hoc membrum Societatis Investigationis Papionum Crispi‑capillatorum, Twanaku Tupián, cutem leviter fuscam, mixturam originum Continentes Septentrionis et Meridionis gerebat. Oculi eius flavos fulgebant, capilli obscuri erant; non tamen deformis, sed indifferens ad vitam habitus eius patebat.

source: At the sight, Lumian’s lips curved into a smile.
target: Visu illo, labia Lumiani in risum incursaverunt.

source: He had sought Hela’s assistance primarily to craft an environment where he could safely unveil his plans after capturing Hisoka alive.
target: Helae auxilium quaesiverat, praesertim ut ambitum pararet in quo consilia sua, post capturam viventem Hisoka, tuto detegere posset.

source: Otherwise, restraining Hisoka’s resistance would have posed a significant challenge. Communicating with him would have been impossible if he remained unconscious until his demise. Destroying Hisoka’s frontal lobe would strip away frustration, pain, and resentment, making it difficult to fulfill the requirements of the Reaper ritual.
target: Alioquin, repugnationem Hisokae reprimere arduum fuisset; communicatio cum eo impossibilis fuisset, si incoscientia mansisset usque ad mortem; delendo lobum frontale eius, frustratio, dolor, atque rancor removerentur, quod difficulter exsequendum ritus Reaper redderet.

source: Upon spotting Lumian, Hisoka suddenly struggled, but an invisible force held him back, preventing his transformation into a Wraith.
target: Lumianem animadvertens, Hisoka repente luctatus est, sed vis invisibilis eum retinuit, ne in umbram se converteret.

source: This was a dream controlled by Hela.
target: Hoc erat somnium a Hela moderatum.

source: Hisoka calmed down and gazed at Lumian, posing the greatest question on his mind, “How did you manage to evade my Danger Premonition?”
target: Hisoka quietus factus, Lumian intuens, maximam quaestionem in mente posuit: “Quomodo praenotionem periculi mei evitavisti?”

source: Lumian’s smile deepened. He looked down at Hisoka and said casually, “No need for a Demon Hunter’s assistance. A sufficient distance and a Hypnotist would do the trick.”
target: Risus Lumiani profundius factus est. Ad Hisoka deorsum aspexit et leviter dixit: “Non opus est auxilio venatoris daemonum; spatium satis et Hypnotista id efficere possunt.”
